correctness.rationale: For k of characteristic two and the full 2^n-dimensional group algebra k[(C_2)^n]=k[x_1,...,x_n]/(x_i^2), multiplication by any a in the augmentation square is square-zero. A degree-two symbol of alternating rank 2r has homogeneous multiplication-homology Hilbert polynomial (2t)^r(1+t)^(n-2r). Cancelling the acyclic graded pairs under an arbitrary degree-at-least-three perturbation leaves an effective homology differential raising degree at least three; for radical/nullity s=n-2r<=2 the homology occupies only degrees r,...,r+s, so that differential vanishes. Hence every lift has multiplication rank (2^n-2^(n-r))/2 and homology dimension 2^(n-r), including r=0. For s>=3 a disjoint cubic z1z2z3 changes homology by tensoring the rank-one cubic differential and increases operator rank exactly 2^(r+s-3). Independent direct bitmask multiplication plus F2 row elimination EXHAUSTED all 2048 elements of the augmentation square for n=4, obtaining multiplicities 0:1,1:1,2:30,4:1120,6:896, and checked n=5 ranks 8 and 10 for uv versus uv+cde. The finite enumeration is a check only, not the proof of the universal cancellation lemma. The field-count orbit formula follows from an alternating-form radical choice and the GL/Sp orbit ratio; no full nonrigid high-dimension census is claimed.

This is more than a renaming or the already-known homogeneous rank computation; no general classification for s>=3 is claimed.
